title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array II
constraints: nums is guaranteed to be rotated at some pivot
description:
There is an integer array `nums` sorted in non-decreasing order (not necessarily with distinct values).

Before being passed to your function, `nums` is **rotated** at an unknown pivot index `k` such that the resulting array is `[nums[k], nums[k+1], ..., nums[n-1], nums[0], nums[1], ..., nums[k-1]]`.

Given the rotated array `nums` and an integer `target`, return `true` if `target` is in `nums`, or `false` if it is not in `nums`.
